us.base: frozen release nexus-v2-shared-20261008 served exactly (ml/v2 rule + TSB + 28-day average); parity on 300 sampled forecasts < 1e-3 units

event.E1c: 25 December closure: F x (h - closed days in window)/h; no parameters

decision_track.success: no shortage in window a..a+R-1 (a = L+2) on actual daily demand

pakistan.series: 15 named categories (primary); uncategorised reported separately; recorded order quantities

event_layer.label: events with >= 2 fit occurrences only; others unadjusted (PENDING decision D3)

pakistan.event_dates: confirmed from official notifications and recorded before the run
pakistan.uncertainty: U0/U1 coverage reported descriptively; no suggestion unless the frozen criterion passes

criteria.event: event-window WAPE >= 5% better at both horizons; non-event and overall WAPE <= +0.5 points; |event bias| not larger; date-block and cluster 95% intervals of the improvement exclude 0; >= 2 fit occurrences per event
criteria.totals_uncertainty: coverage within +/-5 points (+/-10 rare) in event AND non-event windows; >= 200 windows and >= 30 series
criteria.decision_protection: coverage within +/-5 (+/-10 rare) on every pair and scenario at kappa 1 [plus kappa 0.5/1.5 on (7,7) if decision D2 adopts the robust rule]
criteria.scope: a pass authorises a suggestion only for the evaluated market, segment, horizon and level

statistics.occurrences: counted per event; overlapping windows of one occurrence are one occurrence

execution: one runner script, hashed at freeze; refuses a second run (lock file) or any hash mismatch; every outcome reported
